params.prompt: THE CAST PHOTO (the supplied image) shows the only woman in this image; keep her face, skin, age, hair colour and gold stud earrings exactly as shown and use it for her identity and the bedroom only; the pose, framing, time of day and light are new. She is the same 23-year-old white American woman in every shot: honey light-brown shoulder-length hair, small gold stud earrings, light natural brows, natural unretouched skin with only faint fine lines at the outer eye corners, and an oversized heather-grey crewneck sweatshirt with no lettering, logo or print anywhere on it. Late at night in the same bedroom: the room is dark except for the small lamp on the nightstand switched on low, giving a dim warm glow from the frame-right side, and the fairy lights glowing faintly and softly blurred in the background. There is no box anywhere in the frame. She is deeply asleep, lying on her right side facing the lens, her face pressed deep into a soft white pillow: the pillow pushes up her lower cheek and the skin beside her lower eye into soft folds, and the edge of her forehead is pressed into the pillowcase; her face is squashed into the pillow the way a stomach or side sleeper sleeps. Eyes closed, mouth relaxed and closed. The white duvet is pulled up to her shoulder. Her hair is up in the claw clip, off her forehead. Bare face, nothing on her skin. Camera: a phone propped on the nightstand at mattress height, about 50 cm from her face, locked off; a close side view of her face sunk into the pillow, her face about 50% of the frame width, in the middle of the frame. Hands in frame: only her one hand resting on the pillow near her face, five fingers. Keep the top fifth of the frame plain dark wall or soft fairy-light glow with nothing important in it. Shot on a phone: casual vertical phone footage, slightly imperfect framing, natural indoor light, a little phone-camera grain; not a studio, film or ad look. Photorealistic smartphone photo, unretouched, no beauty filter, visible pores and natural skin texture, sharp focus on her face. Her hair is pulled fully back off her forehead. The skin is dry and matte with no cream or lotion. No mirror in the shot. No text, captions, logos or watermark.
